long_biography.plain_text:
Verder Group's transformation from a pump distributor into an international technology manufacturer frames Andries Verder's work. After studying in Vienna and Texas and beginning in management consultancy, he assumed leadership from his father in 2005. He focused the family company on two pillars: industrial pumping systems and scientific instruments.

Acquisitions, new subsidiaries and product development deepened those specialised markets without shifting production to low-cost countries. He argued that application knowledge should stay close to manufacturing, because understanding how customers use equipment guides better products. That operating approach accompanied sustained international expansion while he remained the group's owner and joint chief executive.
